stepTexts.0: Get on your knees. That's your place. Knees on the floor, back straight, mouth ready.
stepTexts.8: On your knees in front of me, you take me. Look up.
stepTexts.24: Stay on your knees. Don't move from there. Keep going.
stepTexts.46: Again. Knees on the floor, you serve me.
stepTexts.64: Good. On your knees is where you're best. You know it now.
